description: This file contains unit tests for the ThingsUpdater class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.thingsearch.updater.actors package. It uses the Akka framework's TestKit to simulate actor behavior, verify message forwarding, and ensure proper blocking behavior. The tests cover forwarding different event types, handling out-of-sync scenarios, and blocking messages based on namespace configurations.

classes.name: ThingsUpdaterTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the behavior of the ThingsUpdater actor in various scenarios, including message forwarding, blocking, and shard region interactions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem, test probes, and blocked namespace cache before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test to release resources.

methods.name: thingEventIsForwarded
methods.description: Verifies that a ThingDeleted event is correctly forwarded as a message envelope.

methods.name: thingTagIsForwarded
methods.description: Checks that a ThingTag is forwarded properly.

methods.name: policyReferenceTagIsForwarded
methods.description: Ensures that a PolicyReferenceTag is forwarded appropriately.

methods.name: forwardUpdateThingOnCommand
methods.description: Tests that an OutOfSync command triggers appropriate message forwarding, considering potential order variations.

methods.name: shardRegionStateIsForwarded
methods.description: Verifies that shard region state inquiries are forwarded.

methods.name: blockAndAcknowledgeMessagesByNamespace
methods.description: Tests the blocking of messages based on namespace and verifies acknowledgments for blocked messages.

methods.name: expectShardedMessage
methods.description: Helper method to verify a message envelope and its contents.

methods.name: createThingsUpdater
methods.description: Creates an instance of the ThingsUpdater actor with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: getMockedShardRegionFactory
methods.description: Creates a mocked ShardRegionFactory that returns a pre-defined actorRef for all region queries.
